description:
Preserve your files long-term ArchiveKeep helps you preserve your personal files by maintaining identical copies across multiple storage locations — without risking corruption or data loss during synchronization. Once a file is archived, it stays unchanged. ArchiveKeep never overwrites existing copies with modifications or corrupted data, ensuring your archives remain intact over time. Features:
  • Plain files — no proprietary format, readable with any application.
  • Incremental synchronization — replicates new files or moves when storages become available, working fully offline.
  • SHA-256 file fingerprinting — fast verification that catches silent bit-rot before it spreads.
  • Multi-platform — available on Linux desktop and Android.
  • No vendor lock-in — you control where your files live.
Optional cloud storages (not required):
  • Google Drive — convenient, familiar, widely available.
  • S3-compatible APIs — choose any vendor that supports the S3 protocol.
Cloud storage is entirely optional. The app works fully offline with local storage only — no Google accounts, no proprietary services, and no internet connection required. Google Drive and S3 are available as optional additions if you want them. ArchiveKeep is in active development and improving with each release. Feedback and bug reports are welcome.
